item.title: Banks Eye $21 Billion Bonds for Broadcom Chip-Financing Deal
item.description: Banks are planning to sell as much as about $21 billion of high-grade bonds as soon as early next year as part of a $63 billion funding package that Broadcom Inc. has pulled together to help finance chips for AI developer Anthropic PBC.

item.title: Indonesia’s MSCI Downgrade Threat – What It Means for Investors: Podcast
item.description: MSCI’s double downgrade warning sparked Indonesia's sharpest market selloff in nearly 30 years. Now, billions in foreign capital are on the line.

item.title: Catastrophe, Rogue AI and Other Anthropic IPO Risks
item.description: Anthropic is headed for what could be history’s biggest IPO, warning that its product could be catastrophic for humanity. On the Big Take podcast, what the share offering means for AI, markets and everyone else. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.description: Barclays Plc strategists expect volatility in Group-of-10 currencies to rise and remain elevated as the dollar strengthens and interest-rate swings increase.
